way/16141015.notes: Mapped as National Botanic Gardens. This is the garden precinct (not a single glasshouse). The RDS founded the gardens; they are now OPW National Botanic Gardens.

relation/78284.notes: The named 'HM Treasury' POI in OSM is a node only (node/5287535091). The occupied building is Government Offices Great George Street (GOGGS), relation/78284, the Treasury's main building on Horse Guards Road. Downing Street terrace is a separate mapped set (see #18).

way/51946562.notes: Mapped as Curraghchase House, a ruin/historic house inside Curraghchase Forest Park (park itself is relation/20983399 — larger than the house). This way is the house footprint.

way/281028379.notes: Mapped as 14 Henrietta Street museum. Encumbered Estates Court sat at this address; this is the building footprint.

way/30643312.notes: Building footprint of Carton House. A separate node/319529548 is a point POI on the same site. Do not use way/30643315 (Carton House Bar).

way/247944755.notes: Camp / military installation outline, not a single barrack block. Relation/4683107 'Curragh' is the plain and is much larger — not used.

relation/78291.notes: Mapped as Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, King Charles Street — the Gilbert Scott building historically the Foreign Office / India Office.

way/30540278.notes: Mapped as Cathal Brugha Barracks — the barracks precinct, not one interior block (Portobello Barracks yard of 1916 is inside this outline).

way/41662413.notes: Gaol building footprint. Stonebreakers' Yard is not a separate named polygon in this extract.

way/51245099.notes: Mapped as Pearse Street Garda Station. Great Brunswick Street was renamed Pearse Street; this is the station building.

way/230613106.notes: The Mansion House on Dawson Street. Round Room is a separate way/275474137 — not used.

relation/1879842.notes: Relation for No. 10. Terrace/security zone is larger than the famous door frontage.

way/38376253.notes: Mapped as National Concert Hall — the former UCD / Royal University building on Earlsfort Terrace. Do not use way/38376254 (visitor parking).
